description: PHASE 1 - Data Layer: Prisma schema with pgvector, SQL migrations for cosine similarity search, and Zod shared types for all API payloads.
steps: Create packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma with: Event model (id UUID, name String, date DateTime, expiry DateTime, pricing_tier enum FREE/STANDARD/PREMIUM), Photo model (id UUID, event_id FK, original_key String, social_key String, thumbnail_key String, metadata_json Json), FaceEmbedding model (id UUID, photo_id FK, embedding Unsupported('vector(512)')). Use postgresql provider with pgvector extension.

Create packages/database/prisma/migrations/00001_init/migration.sql - full DDL for creating tables with proper indexes, foreign keys, and the pgvector extension (CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector)

Create packages/database/prisma/migrations/00002_search_function/migration.sql - the search_wedding_photos RPC function using cosine similarity: takes a query_embedding vector(512) and match_threshold float, returns photos ordered by similarity using the <=> operator
Create packages/database/src/index.ts - exports PrismaClient instance with proper connection pooling config from DATABASE_URL env
Create packages/shared-types/src/schemas/event.schema.ts - Zod schemas: CreateEventInput (name, date, expiry, pricing_tier), EventResponse, UpdateEventInput

Create packages/shared-types/src/schemas/upload.schema.ts - Zod schemas: PresignedUrlRequest (event_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, total_chunks), PresignedUrlResponse (upload_id, urls array, chunk_size), CompleteUploadRequest
Create packages/shared-types/src/schemas/photo.schema.ts - Zod schemas: PhotoMetadata, PhotoResponse, FaceSearchRequest (embedding vector), FaceSearchResponse
Create packages/shared-types/src/schemas/common.schema.ts - shared Zod schemas: PaginationInput, PaginatedResponse, ApiError, UUID validator
acceptance_criteria: Prisma schema defines Event, Photo, FaceEmbedding models with correct field types
FaceEmbedding uses vector(512) type via Unsupported annotation for pgvector
SQL migration includes CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector
search_wedding_photos function uses cosine distance operator (<=>)
All Zod schemas export inferred TypeScript types using z.infer
Shared types package has barrel export from src/index.ts
verification: Verify Prisma schema file exists and contains all 3 models with correct relations
Verify migration SQL files exist and contain pgvector extension + search function
Verify Zod schemas export both schema objects and inferred types
findings: All files created successfully. Cannot run full tsc type-check due to missing node_modules (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network), but verified: 1) All TS files are syntactically valid (balanced braces/brackets/parens), 2) Prisma schema contains all 3 models with correct types and pgvector extension, 3) SQL migrations include CREATE EXTENSION vector and search_wedding_photos with <=> operator, 4) All Zod schema files export both schema objects and z.infer types, 5) Barrel index.ts re-exports all schemas. tsconfig.json files for both packages already existed from FEAT-001.
